newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo trade to resume in Banespa.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo trade to resume in Banespa.

text.p: Trade in shares of troubled Brazilian state bank Banespa was slated to resume at midday on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange, a day after trade was suspended, a bolsa spokeswoman said.
"As of midday, trading in Banespa will resume," the spokeswoman told Reuters,
Trade in Sao Paulo state-owned Banespa was suspended Tuesday after a newspaper reported the bank posted a 786.3 million-real net profit in the first nine months.

Both the Sao Paulo bourse and Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) requested additional information on the company's financial results and the bolsa suspended trade in the bank's shares until it received the data.
"The information was provided and it was announced that trade would resume at midday," the spokeswoman said.
